references.supports: Mirambo, Gieshübler's factotum, nicknamed after an African chief

notes.rationale: »Mirambo kann nicht fahren«, Gieshübler's factotum, who can't drive the sleigh since a horse kicked him, a nickname used as a given name (Masc, Rule de/proper-noun-article). No dictionary splits it within German, and a PROPN has no Source (ADR 0050 gives Sources to NOUN, VERB and ADJ only), so it is a bottom word: the Root mirambo and the zero ending, since PROPN has an ending slot (ADR 0051).
